default.aim: Choose multiplication or division for equal groups, then check the units.

build.aim: Combine given quantities where needed, then decide whether the answer needs full groups, another group, a remainder or an exact share.

confidence.aim: Link calculations and interpret an intermediate result before using it.

answerNote: In exams, include the correct units in your working and final answer (including £ for money). In this app, enter just the number; the answer field shows the required unit.
